text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being here right now is all thanks to 
everyone— K.S. Miracle speaks of repaying 
those around her, bringing about a 
miracle, and securing a GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A strong, unyielding will, coupled with 
the peril of being "too hesitant-free." 
The three-legged race of days alongside a 
girl holding such a double-edged heart had 
begun.
